summary_en: TOC revised its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 from 10.00 yen per share to 11.00 yen per share, comprising interim and year-end dividends of 5.50 yen each, up 0.50 yen per quarter.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
TOC Co., Ltd. announced on September 16, 2026 a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company increased its expected annual dividend per share from 10.00 yen to 11.00 yen, raising both the interim dividend (as of September 30, 2026) and the year-end dividend (as of March 31, 2027) from 5.00 yen to 5.50 yen per share respectively.

The company stated that this revision reflects the trend of current period earnings. The adjustment is consistent with the company's basic dividend policy, which aims to maintain stable and continuous dividends while giving due consideration to future business development and reinforcement of the management foundation through retained earnings. The decision was made by the board of directors at its meeting on September 16, 2026.
